name: Yamaha Royal Star
engine: 1294 cc liquid-cooled V4, four carbs, shaft drive
intro: A smooth V4 cruiser. Four carbs that need clean floats, intact vacuum caps and a good sync.

add.title: Check the carb vacuum caps
add.instructions: Check the rubber caps on the carb sync ports. They often split where the clamps go. Replace any that are cracked.
add.reason: A split cap is an air leak that makes one cylinder run lean.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Float levels
known.what: Owners report float levels out of adjustment causing fuel overflow and poor running.
